{{Quote|Do not deviate from your current course until we have confirmed your cargo.|K2-B4|<ref name="TC" />}}
'''K2-B4''' was a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] who served [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]] at the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the Clone Wars, K2-B4 assisted Commander [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]] in guarding [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] and their [[Officer/Legends|officers]] while they were being [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] for information on the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]]. K2-B4 then scanned a [[Class type B/Legends|supply shuttle's]] cargo. However, K2-B4 then informed Sobeck that the supply shuttle never arrived.<sup> </sup>K2-B4 then informed Sobeck that [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] was waiting to speak with him via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. K2-B4 then discovered the missing supply shuttle and had [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] [[R2-D2's battle droid squadron|battle droids]] taken to the interrogation center.<sup>[4]</sup>

==Biography==
{{Quote|The prisoners are escaping with reprogrammed battle droids. Let no one on board that shuttle.|K2-B4 to a battle droid|<ref name="CA">{{TCW|Counterattack}}</ref>}}
[[File:K2B4R2D2_CA.png|thumb|left|250px|K2-B4 captures [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]]]
This feminine tactical droid was stationed inside [[Citadel Command/Legends|Citadel Command]], alongside Osi Sobeck and a few [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|security droids]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA-2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] was [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|captured]] and detained in the Citadel, prompting an elite team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] to [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|rescue]] him. When they entered the atmosphere of the planet, [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]], the planet holding the Citadel, K2-B4 contacted them and asked about their cargo. She then told them to stay on course while she scanned the ship for life forms using the scanners. However, because the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and clones had encased themselves in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], the scanners did not detect them and K2-B4 allowed them to enter Lola Sayu.<ref name="TC" />

Later on, K2-B4 informed Sobeck that Confederacy [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] wanted to contact him because of the Jedi's success of freeing Master Piell and his men. After reassuring the Count that everything was under control, Sobeck grabbed K2-B4 and warned her never to surprise him like that again. K2-B4 later met with [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] shuttle after getting suspicious that it was long overdue. R2 was being escorted by [[R2-D2's battle droid squadron/Legends|three battle droids]], including [[OOM-10/Legends|OOM-10]] who unknown to K2-B4 had been reprogrammed to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. They managed to fool K2-B4 into thinking that R2 was their prisoner and were taking him for interrogation. However, when R2 and the captured Jedi and his team never reached the interrogation room, K2-B4 realized OOM-10 and the battle droids' reprogramming and alerted all Citadel guards to capture them.<ref name="CA" />

She was later transferred aboard a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]] orbiting Lola Sayu and was ordered by Sobeck not to let anyone past their defenses. However, when a rescue fleet under the command of four Jedi Masters arrived, K2-B4 failed to prevent them from entering the planet, and the Jedi successfully extracted the remaining members of the team and escaped back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CR">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
K2-B4 was voiced by [[Ashley Eckstein]], who also provided the voice of [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in the series. She is the first tactical droid whose designation does not begin with a 'T'.

K2-B4's name is a reference to basketball player [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kobe_Bryant Kobe Bryant], who wore the jersey number 24 during the latter part of his career. Her color scheme of purple and gold matches that of the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles_Lakers Los Angeles Lakers], who Bryant played his entire career for. These references were included by Lakers fans on the crew of ''The Clone Wars'', as the Lakers won the NBA championship during production of "The Citadel".<ref name="The Citadel Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode318.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Citadel}}</ref>
